svg.text: High-level architecture as built (21 Nov 2026). Entry point: python -m hfteama.demo wires everything below. Plug in more SO-101 arms and the work re-splits live.
Qwen3-VL points at every pickable object
pixel ray ∩ table plane → (x, y) metres
stable object ids in the table frame
VLM sorts objects into bin categories
fresh frame + same VLM confirms a place
which live arms reach each step's *_xyz
deps done + arm free + zone free
its step back to the pool
task folders add their own via
so IK / FK / sim agree with real arms
plan vs actual Gantt, limit in words
event log → same Screen as Dash
loopback by default; needs --orchestra-token on the network
commands (go · pause · stop-all · plug · remove · fail)
start / pause / add_arm / remove_arm · plug / unplug
solid = data / call · dashed = feedback · ↔ = request / response
